targets.text: Bahubali Subhash Khot
■ +91 6362588038| khotbahubali07@gmail.com | ■ Pune, Maharashtra – 411018
CLIENT OPERATIONS | CLIENT SERVICES | CUSTODY OPERATIONS | TRADE
I hereby declare that the information provided is true and accurate to the best of my knowledge.
PROCESSING AND TRADE SETTLEMENT
DECLARATION
Bahubali S. Khot
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Client-focused Capital Markets Operations professional with 4.8 years of experience in Client Operations,
Custody Operations, Trade Settlement, Reconciliation, and issue resolution. Experienced in managing client
and counterparty inquiries, operational requests, escalations, settlement exceptions, and follow-ups through
resolution. Strong ability to coordinate with cross-functional teams, maintain service quality, meet SLA-driven
deadlines, analyze operational issues, prepare service and reconciliation reports, maintain accurate records, and
identify process gaps for continuous improvement. Hands-on exposure to Equities, Fixed Income, Mutual
Funds, FX, and Repo/Reverse Repo across global markets.
ROLE-ALIGNED CORE SKILLS
Client Inquiry & Request Management
Issue Resolution & Root-Cause Analysis
Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination
KPI / Service Metrics & Operational Reporting
Custody Operations & Client Servicing
Settlement Investigation & Exception Management • Process Improvement
Service Gap Identification
Risk Controls, Audit & Compliance
Trade Lifecycle Management
TECHNICAL & ANALYTICAL SKILLS
Stock Reconciliation | SWIFT MT54X | DTC | FED
Operational Platforms: IIP | MCH | STS
Client Relationship Support
Client Escalation Management
Service Delivery & SLA Management
Client Communication & Follow-up
Cash & Securities Reconciliation
SOP & Process Documentation
Global Market Operations
Advanced Excel | SQL | Power BI | Bloomberg
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Infosys BPM Ltd. — Process Specialist – Trade Settlement
22 January 2026 – 24 July 2026 | Pune
Supported client operations and custody settlement activities, including client onboarding and transition
support.
Managed and responded to operational queries and requests related to trade settlement, reconciliation, and
custody activities, ensuring timely follow-up.
Investigated cash and securities reconciliation breaks and settlement exceptions; coordinated with relevant internal
teams until resolution.
Acted as a liaison between middle-office, reconciliation, and operations teams to facilitate clear communication
and timely issue resolution.
Managed daily queue allocation, workflow tracking, and work prioritization to support SLA commitments and
service delivery.
Prepared and maintained SOPs, process documentation, and operational guidelines to ensure consistent and
accurate service delivery.
Identified operational gaps and contributed to process improvement initiatives focused on workflow efficiency and
service quality.
Maintained accurate operational records and supported transition activities through structured documentation and
follow-up.
State Street Services Pvt. Ltd., Pune — Senior Associate (Trade Processing & Settlement)
01 December 2021 – 15 January 2026 | Pune
Handled client and counterparty queries and escalations related to trade settlement, payments,
reconciliation, and operational exceptions, ensuring professional follow-up through closure.
Built effective working relationships with custodians, agent banks, counterparties, Euroclear, Clearstream, and
internal stakeholders to resolve service issues.
Managed end-to-end trade lifecycle activities including trade booking, validation, confirmation, settlement,
reconciliation, and exception management across global markets.
Performed cash and securities reconciliation, investigated settlement breaks and trade failures, identified causes,
and drove timely resolution within SLA.
Coordinated with cross-functional teams to resolve domestic and international settlement, payment, transfer, and
custody-related issues.
Processed custody settlements through FED, DTC, CREST, SWIFT, and FAX instructions, while ensuring market
cut-off and service timelines were met.
Executed and monitored transactions across Equities, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds, FX, and Repo/Reverse Repo
products.
Processed DVP, RVP, and FOP transactions and handled amendments, cancellations, FX currency matching, and
settlement requirements.
Prepared SOD, MOD, EOD, reconciliation, and operational reports to support service monitoring, control checks,
SLA adherence, audit readiness, and regulatory requirements.
Allocated and posted dividend and interest income accurately to client accounts and supported accurate
custody/accounting records.
Identified recurring operational issues and service gaps and contributed to process improvements and workflow
enhancements.
Maintained 99.8% accuracy while managing high-volume transactions in a deadline-driven environment.
Mentored new team members and supported knowledge transfer, process consistency, and service-quality
standards.
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Titan Award – June 2022
Bravo Awards – Multiple recognitions (2024–2025)
Promoted to Senior Associate (March 2025) within 3 years
Maintained 99.8% processing accuracy in high-volume, SLA-driven operations
Client / Operations: Custody Operations | Client Servicing | Settlement Investigations | Exception Management | Cash &
Reporting & Analytics: Advanced Excel | Excel VBA | SQL | Power BI | Bloomberg Terminal
EDUCATION
MBA (Finance) — Visvesvaraya Technological University | CGPA: 7.85
BBA (Finance) — Rani Channamma University | 73.03%

targets.text: Leveraged industry-leading cybersecurity technologies including Nessus, Qualys, Wiz
Cloud, Prisma Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, KQL, SIEM, Nmap, Kali Linux, CSPM, CWPP, Jira,
ServiceMax, XMCO to enhance threat detection, vulnerability management, cloud
security, and security operations effectiveness.
Project Manager | Samona Limited, London, United Kingdom
June 2024 – May 2025
Supported the CISO in overseeing enterprise Security Operations and Incident Response
functions, serving as the escalation focal point for critical cybersecurity incidents, complex
investigations, and high-risk security events to ensure timely resolution and effective risk
mitigation.
Partnered with the CISO to drive SOC maturity and operational excellence initiatives,
providing guidance, governance, and capability development across L1/L2/L3 security
teams to enhance detection, response, and operational effectiveness.
Led and supervised major security incident investigations, coordinating cross-functional
teams to perform root cause analysis, validate findings through log analysis, assess
business impact, and provide executive-level reporting and recommendations.
Supported the CISO in advancing Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting programs by
overseeing proactive threat detection activities, identifying emerging threats, and
strengthening organizational resilience against advanced cyber adversaries.
Acted as a trusted cybersecurity advisor to business and technology stakeholders,
delivering risk-based security insights, recommendations, and governance support to
improve security posture and support informed decision-making.
Directed enterprise vulnerability and risk assessment initiatives, leveraging security tools
and threat intelligence to identify, prioritize, and communicate risks based on exploitability,
business impact, and organizational exposure.
Collaborated with Cloud, Infrastructure, Network, DevSecOps, and Development teams to
establish remediation strategies, oversee risk treatment plans, and drive security
improvements that reduce the organization's attack surface.
Supported the CISO in the governance and expansion of Security Operations Center (SOC)
capabilities, including onboarding new services, enhancing monitoring use cases, and
optimizing Microsoft Sentinel-based detection and response programs.
Governed Vulnerability Management programs by overseeing security assessments,
tracking remediation efforts, validating risk reduction activities, and reporting security
posture improvements to executive leadership.
Utilized enterprise security technologies including Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM, EDR,
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Qualys, MITRE ATT&CK, KQL, and Python to support
security monitoring, threat detection, Risk Assessment, and strategic cybersecurity
initiatives.
SOC Lead Specialist | Fortuna Identity Pvt. Ltd, Hyderabad, India
Duration: March 2022 - May 2024
Data Loss Prevention and Incident Management: Monitor and respond to potential
threats to ensure systems and data confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
Event/Event Analysis: If enough agents are deployed to IDS, IPS, firewall, server, and any
other security device, logging is performed to detect significant security or anomalies.
Use of Microsoft Sentinel SIEM: Microsoft Sentinel collects and correlates security data,
making it easier to detect and investigate threats.
Azure Lighthouse and Detection Config: Create Azure Lighthouse scripts to onboard
customers' tenants, configure detection analytics rules, define a data connector, and
challenge KQL queries to improve visibility.
Incident Documentation and triaging: Triage and prioritize incidents, document actions
taken, gather evidence, and record remediation steps and lessons learned.
Stakeholder communication and security awareness: Communicate clearly with
stakeholders, provide updates on security incidents, work with team members, and
promote security best practices across the organization.
Digital Forensic Consultant - Glorywebs Creative Pvt. Ltd., Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
Duration - April 2019 - February 2022
Supported crime investigations in a forensic capacity that led to multiple successful
prosecutions (child exploitation, money laundering, and fraud investgation) that directly
resulted in industry regulation and changes in law enforcement methodologies.
I have worked with law enforcement agencies such as the Central Bureau of Investigation,
Goods and Service Tax Department, and Income Tax Department to support fraud and
criminal investigations, supporting more industry-wide anti-fraud efforts.
Assisted in producing user guides and writing SOPs for technician processes as part of
onboarding new starters and knowledge embedding.
Forensic tools through copying digital evidence and securing data
integrity and
admissibility of digital data.
Oversee the examination of data pulled from computers, smartphones, and hard drives to
various forensic devices. Understand Windows artifacts on the file system level.
Have hands-on experience with forensics hard drives. The suspect attempted to wipe,
delete, or refer to ID, Marking a hard drive with improper identification. Hardware fixes on
phones; data retrieval.
Write a statement and create a report that was later submitted to the court.
Tools Used: FTK, EnCase, Oxygen Forensic, Intella, Deft Zero, Mobiledit, BackupTrans
Founder/Director - Global IT Solutions– Bharuch, Gujarat, India
Duration – July 2017 - March 2019
IT Consulting and Services, Hardware Supply, Troubleshooting and AMC Services.
IT Specialist - Trio Hat Intelligence, Bharuch, Gujarat, India
March 2013 - June 2017
Provided end-to-end IT support including system maintenance, troubleshooting, network
management, and implementation of secure and efficient technology solutions.
Cyber Security Summer Internship: Gurugram Police – July 2021
Education
Master of Technology (M.Tech) in Cybersecurity
Rashtriya Raksha University, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India
CGPA: 7.89 out of 10
Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Information Technology
Gujarat Technological University, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
CGPA: 7.12 out of 10
Certifications and Achievements
Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) – ISACA
Innovation Excellence Award at ROI E-Solutions – October 2024
SC-200: Microsoft Security Operations Analyst – April 2024
Mentoring and Volunteer Work
September 2024 to December 2024
Contribution to Security Operations Center with Microsoft Sentinel Mentoring Program

context.text: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) under Tumkur university from Kalpataru First grade college, Tiptur
Working as ServiceNow Developer for Inventus Info Consulting (INFOSYS), Bangalore from

targets.text: Project
NEXTEC
Description
The project focused on improving Configuration Management
Database (CMDB) health by implementing Discovery, Service
Mapping, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), and
CMDB Data Manager. The objective was to improve Configuration
Item (CI) accuracy, automate infrastructure discovery, and establish
service relationships for better IT Operations visibility.
Technologies
Responsibilities
ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, IRE, MID
Server, JavaScript, Flow Designer, REST APIs
Configured Discovery schedules for Windows, Linux, VMware,
Network Devices, and Cloud resources.
Installed, configured, and upgraded MID Servers across multiple
environments.
Customized CI Class Manager and CMDB Data Model.
Integrated Discovery with AWS, Azure, VMware, and
Kubernetes environments.
Configured Event Management integrations with SolarWinds,
Dynatrace, Splunk, and Nagios.
Created REST API integrations for CI synchronization with
external asset repositories.
Implemented Service Mapping for critical business applications.
Customized Discovery Patterns and Probes.
Worked on Identification & Reconciliation Rules (IRE).
Improved CMDB Health Dashboard and Data Certification.
Developed Business Rules, Script Includes, and Client Scripts.
Integrated third-party inventory tools using REST APIs.
Created reports for CI completeness and compliance.
Supported production issues and Discovery troubleshooting.
DECLARATION:
I hereby declare that the information furnished above is true to the best of my
knowledge.
(Bhavyashree RY)
